subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: What authorization and routing contract should govern a channel user temporarily switching the current conversation to another configured agent?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the feature changes which agent owns a live chat and can cross workspace, credential, tool, memory, and transcript boundaries.

options.title: Authorized conversation switch
options.body: Define a server-owned, opt-in `/agent <id>` contract with an explicit target allowlist and per-agent session isolation before implementation.

options.title: Subagent-only focus model
options.body: Keep channel rerouting limited to spawned or explicitly bound sessions and document `sessions_spawn` plus `/focus` as the supported path.

options.title: Static bindings only
options.body: Decline dynamic chat switching and keep agent/channel ownership controlled only by operator-edited bindings and Gateway restart or reload.

recommendation.title: Authorized conversation switch
recommendation.body: Define a server-owned, opt-in `/agent <id>` contract with an explicit target allowlist and per-agent session isolation before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history signal across configured routing, command registry, and maintainer-side multi-agent route behavior.
